description: As a team member I want to create a work item with a title and optional description so that I can track tasks

acceptance_criteria.description: Work item must have a non-empty title

description: As a team member I want to mark a work item as done so that I can track completion time

acceptance_criteria.description: Completion timestamp must be recorded when marked done

description: As a team member I want to delete a work item so that I can remove completed tasks

acceptance_criteria.description: Only work items owned by the user can be deleted

description: As a team member I want to list all work items so that I can see the current task list

acceptance_criteria.description: List must include title, description, status, and completion timestamp
List must be sorted by creation time
